title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
description: Every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place, after OpenAI's 2026 manuscript. Cyclic covers of a twist branched at two points; integral homology over the group ring and Picard-Lefschetz transvections; congruences between character pieces; local constancy of reduction types; Hilbert irreducibility for a curve and its conjugate; three applications of the Caraiani-Newton lifting theorem; cyclic descent; complex multiplication.
